notes: Fresh blind replication-only validation. Published article version, DOI/title/authors match supplied reference. PDF p. 9 visually inspected. Audit IDs 1980 and 1981 have the same replication page locator and the same neutral description covering knowledge, attitudes and behavioural intentions. Their outcome/test assignments cannot be distinguished without inferring from input order or consulting prohibited material. Knowledge section prints condition, time and interaction F tests plus several follow-ups; attitude section prints condition, time and interaction F tests plus pairwise comparisons. No arbitrary test selected. Page 5 gives recruitment/condition totals and page 8 Table 1 gives generic condition Ns, which do not establish a unique target-test analytic N. Canonical text renders less-than signs as backslashes and eta-squared as gp2; rendered PDF confirms conventional mathematical symbols. No quote normalization or metric conversion performed. Original is an unassigned placeholder, not a finding that its paper is unavailable.
